notes.title: Power Pals Now Available! Launch Promotions Starting Now!
notes.notes:
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/41054751/cf5371a6869c70822d9d4bd572b817959ab5cc01.png[/img]

[h1]Launch Promotions[/h1]
As an added bonus for the launch of Power Pals, a total of 6 winners will receive a copy of Dungeon Overseer(via Steam chat as a Steam key).  There are two ways to win!

[b]Blitterbom Promotion[/b]
The first player and only the first player to share a [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1722890/screenshots/]community screenshot[/url] of their fight with Blitterbom the evil dragon [u]on level 8(the last level)[/u] will receive 1 copy of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1693430/Dungeon_Overseer/]Dungeon Overseer[/url].  Once you have shared the screenshot in the Steam community put a link in this announcement, first linked screenshot of their fight with Blitterbom the evil dragon on level 8 in the announcement is the winner.

[b]Community Screenshot Promotion[/b]
It's easy to participate.  Just share a screenshot of your gameplay in Power Pals [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1722890/screenshots/]community screenshot[/url] or fan art if you choose.  On Sept. 3rd our [u]5 favorite screenshots or fan art images[/u] will be chosen from Power Pals steam [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1722890/screenshots/]community screenshots[/url] and 5 different winners(you can only win once) will receive 1 copy of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1693430/Dungeon_Overseer/]Dungeon Overseer[/url].  Winners will be announced on the store page on Sept 4th for transparency and sent a friend invite to chat for their Steam key.

notes.title: Power Pals Multi Language Additions
notes.notes:
Hello!  Power Pals is happy to announce that it is now available in 9 languages.  The finishing touches are being applied and soon you too can be a Power Pal!

Support Languages Include:

English
French
German
Russian
Japanese
Simplified Chinese
Traditional Chinese
Spanish(latin america)
Turkish

notes.title: Power Pals Coming Soon
notes.notes:
Power Pals is coming soon!  The final touches and sprinkles of magic are being applied and will be available to everyone soon!  Here is a brief overview of what to expect while playing Power Pals!

Become a Power Pal and help the team save their children from the evil Blitterbom.  Power Pals is an arcade style platformer with a cute family friendly atmosphere.  Play through increasingly difficult levels as one of the 5 Power Pals.  Collect Paw coins to spend on a variety of things in the upgrade shop.  In the shop you can unlock new Power Pals and upgrade their abilities.  Share upgrades across your Pals and jump through the levels.  Collect power ups to help defeat the bad guys as you progress towards multiple bosses.  Help save the Power Pals children and defeat the evil Blitterbom.

[h2]FEATURES[/h2]

[b]5 Different Power Pals To Play[/b]
[list][*]Bongo The Elephant
[*]Rocky The Crocodile
[*]Sniffles The Giraffe
[*]Bubbles The Hippo
[*]Or Ronny The Lion[/list]

[b]Upgrade abilities in the Power Pal shop[/b]
[list][*]Upgrade your run speed
[*]Upgrade your jump high height
[*]Upgrade the amount of continuous jumps in a row
[*]Share upgrades between pals![/list]

[b]Purchase more lives in the Power Pal Shop[/b]
[list][*]Collect paw coins to purchase more lives
[*]There is no limit to the number of extra lives
[*]Make sure you collect all of the Paw coins![/list]

[b]Collect Power Ups[/b]
[list][*]Collect the wisp friend to help you dispatch enemies and bosses
[*]Collect the lightning power up to turn invulnerable for a short time
[*]Use all of these to survive run out of lives and its game over[/list]

Power Pals is sure to bring a smile to your face as you take these adventuresome rascals through to victory and save their children from the evil Blitterbom
